name: @equin/plugin-framework-list-catalog
description:
The list catalog's vocabulary: a list entry's FACT — its plain-data half, with a code marker where a field is code (factOf, shared by the build that writes the catalog and the page that checks it) — the Fact

type on which code fields do not exist, and the catalog's shapes (each declared web list, each entry with the plugin it came from).
